title: Keep LangSmith tracing optional, PII-free, and non-blocking on webhooks
context_summary: LINE webhooks require fast deterministic responses under the 2.5s Race SLA.
observation: Missing optional telemetry env vars or slow trace POSTs must never block customer replies.
verified_action: Export only PII-free metadata (tenant/team/agent/latency/outcome) asynchronously with safe catch guards.
